correctness.rationale: The four channel Kraus output vectors yield two symmetric Wootters spin-flip Gram blocks with singular values sqrt(A²+B²)+A, sqrt(A²+B²)-A, B, B (A=q|ad-bc|, B=q(1-q)|d|²). Their concurrence is 2q[|ad-bc|-(1-q)|d|²]_+, so survival is equivalent to |ad-bc|>u|d|² for u=1-q. Independent circular complex Gaussians conditional on (C,D) give determinant a circular Gaussian of variance Y=|C|²+|D|². X=|D|²/Y is Uniform[0,1], independent gamma(2,1) Y; integration E[e^{-u²YX²}]=integral_0^1(1+u²x²)^{-2}dx yields S(q) exactly. Endpoint limits give the time atom and asymptotics; at exactly q=0 output is always separable but infinite-time T is defined by absence of finite death. Independently reconstructed 75 random Kraus spin-flip concurrences with maximum analytic discrepancy <4e-13; finite checks corroborate, not prove Haar integration.

final_claim: For complex Haar-random two-qubit pure inputs and two identical independent zero-temperature amplitude damping channels, 0<q<=1, survival of nonzero concurrence has probability S(q)=1/[2(1+(1-q)^2)]+atan(1-q)/[2(1-q)]. For q=e^{-gamma t}, finite death probability (6-pi)/8 and atom at T=infinity (2+pi)/8; small-time death probability 2gamma^2 t^2/3+O(t^3).
